draft.card.reason.tankShred: {{winner}} can cut through the enemy frontline.
draft.card.reason.resistVsDamage: {{winner}} resists the rival’s main damage type.
draft.card.reason.splitDuel: {{winner}} has the edge in a side-lane duel.
draft.card.reason.invadeVsFarm: {{winner}} can invade while the rival needs to farm.
draft.card.reason.counterGank: {{winner}} can turn a rival gank into a winning skirmish.
draft.card.reason.engageVsEnchanter: {{winner}} can force a fight onto the enchanter.
draft.card.reason.pokeVsEngage: {{winner}} chips away before the rival can engage.
draft.card.reason.assassinVsCarry: {{winner}} can reach a carry with few escapes.
draft.card.reason.disengageVsEngage: {{winner}} can break off the rival’s engage.
draft.card.reason.peelVsDive: {{winner}} can protect allies when the rival dives.
draft.card.reason.aoeVsGrouped: {{winner}} punishes enemies that bunch up in melee.
draft.card.reason.engageVsPoke: {{winner}} can close the gap before poke takes its toll.
draft.card.reason.lockdownVsCarry: {{winner}} can pin down the enemy carry.
draft.card.reason.hookVsImmobile: {{winner}} can hook a target with few escapes.
draft.card.reason.hypercarryPeel: Protection buys the hypercarry time to deal damage.
draft.card.reason.pokeSiege: They can wear down defenders during a siege.
draft.card.reason.chainCc: They can chain their crowd control.
draft.card.reason.knockupUlt: The knock-up sets up Yasuo’s ultimate.
draft.card.reason.earlyDuo: Both can pressure the bot lane early.
draft.card.reason.scalingDuo: Their protection and damage grow stronger together.
draft.card.reason.pickVision: Vision and catches let them isolate a target.
draft.card.reason.splitPressure: They threaten a side lane while the group holds mid.
draft.card.reason.damageMix: They combine physical and magic damage.
draft.card.reason.diveTogether: Both can reach the enemy backline together.
draft.card.reason.enchanterDiver: The enchanter keeps the diver fighting.
draft.card.reason.frontToBack: The tank buys space for the ranged carry.

draft.stage.plan.title: Game plan
draft.plan.heading: {{team}}: game plan
draft.plan.intro: Choose how your team plays this game. The suggestion comes from both drafts; change anything you want.
draft.plan.noReasons: Both drafts are even, so the balanced plan is suggested.
draft.plan.tempo.hint: How fast your team forces fights and moves around the map.
draft.plan.tempo.slow.hint: Farm, wait for the late game and avoid early fights.
draft.plan.tempo.balanced.hint: Adapt to how the game goes.
draft.plan.tempo.fast.hint: Force fights early and snowball before the rival scales.
draft.plan.objectives.dragon.hint: Contest every dragon to build a lasting advantage.
draft.plan.objectives.baron.hint: Give up dragons to secure Baron and end the game.
draft.plan.risk.hint: How much your team gambles on fights and plays.
draft.plan.risk.safe.hint: Fewer gambles: fewer big swings, for you and for the rival.
draft.plan.risk.balanced.hint: Take a fight when the odds are good.
draft.plan.risk.risky.hint: Look for big plays: more upside, but more ways to lose.
draft.plan.cause.tempo.own.early.up: Your champions are strong early, so playing fast pays off.
draft.plan.cause.tempo.own.late.down: Your champions scale into the late game, so there is no need to rush.
draft.plan.cause.tempo.rival.early.down: The rival is strong early: playing slow denies them their moment.
draft.plan.cause.tempo.rival.late.up: The rival scales into the late game: end it before they do.
draft.plan.cause.objectives.early.up: You have more early-game champions than the rival: take dragons while it counts.
draft.plan.cause.objectives.early.down: The rival has more early-game champions: avoid dragon fights and go for Baron.
draft.plan.cause.objectives.mid.up: The rival is stronger in the mid game: take dragons before it arrives.
draft.plan.cause.objectives.mid.down: You are stronger in the mid game: Baron is within reach.
draft.plan.cause.objectives.engage.up: You have more engage than the rival: fight for dragons.
draft.plan.cause.objectives.engage.down: The rival has more engage: avoid dragon fights and go for Baron.
draft.plan.cause.objectives.poke.up: The rival has more poke: fight for dragons before they wear you down.
draft.plan.cause.objectives.poke.down: You have more poke than the rival: sieging for Baron suits you.
draft.plan.cause.objectives.splitpush.up: The rival has more split-pushers: take dragons to keep the map under control.
draft.plan.cause.objectives.splitpush.do: You have more split-pushers: Baron frees them to push.
draft.plan.cause.risk.engage.up: You have more engage than the rival: take the fights.
draft.plan.cause.risk.engage.down: The rival has more engage: avoid their fights.
draft.plan.cause.risk.poke.up: The rival has more poke: force fights before they wear you down.
draft.plan.cause.risk.poke.down: You have more poke than the rival: wait and play safe.
draft.plan.cause.risk.late.up: The rival scales better: you need bold plays to win.
draft.plan.cause.risk.late.down: You scale better: playing safe wins in the end.
